lena (Recruiting Ops): flagging a weird one 
We imported 150 candidate records from the new vendor feed and several panels show up with empty scorecards in the ATS. Not missing responsesadadad
the scorecard itself is blank (no template attached).
pri (People Ops): ugh. which candidates? any common source?
lena (Recruiting Ops): vendor batch id vfeed-2026-03-22, examples: CAN-331, CAN-334, CAN-340. All from the same CSV.
nats-import-bot: import job job-4921 completed status=partial_success warnings=12
ats-import-bot: sample row payload (sanitized):
```
{"candidate_id":"CAN-331","panel_id":"P-998","interviewer_emails":["alex@redwood.io"],"scorecard_template_id":null}
```
omar (SRE): `scorecard_template_id` should never be null. Looks like an upstream transform sanitized the field when the template wasn't found in the vendor mapping.
pri (People Ops): vendor told us they changed the column name from `template_ref` -> `score_template` last week. Our importer maps `template_ref`. If the importer can't find the template name, it sets `null` and we end up attaching an empty card.
lena (Recruiting Ops): consequence: interviewers receive scheduled invites with a scorecard link that opens blank. We've already had 2 panels with missing feedback after the interview.
omar (SRE): quick mitigation: I can update the importer to reject rows where template is missing (fail the row) so we don't create panels without templates. Will push a validation within 30m and re-run the import for failed rows only.
scorecard-service-bot: note: detach-blank-card-script queued job detach-1578 (will mark panels with blank cards as "needs review")
pri (People Ops): thanks. long-term we should: 1) make importer accept both `template_ref` and `score_template` keys 2) add a preflight check that cross-references template names against ATS catalog and rejects unknown ones 3) notify hiring owner when rows are rejected so they can fix vendor CSVs.
lena (Recruiting Ops): can we also add a calendar-hold for reassigned panels if a card is blank? interviewers are confused when link opens to a blank form. cal-bot can we put a temporary note on those invites?
cal-bot: command acknowledged: adding invite note "scorecard missing - hold for review" to P-998, P-1002.
omar (SRE): deploy plan: 
- hotfix importer to accept alias `score_template` and treat missing as reject (deploy id hotfix-540).
- backfill: reprocess only rows where `scorecard_template_id` was null (job reproc-441).
- alerting: create a monitor on import job with threshold >5 null-template rows per import.
pri (People Ops): I'll message vendor channel and request corrected CSV format. Also adding an item to the hiring-ops runbook: "verify scorecard template mapping before bulk imports".
lena (Recruiting Ops): noted. I'll triage today's panels and reach out to interviewers affected to collect feedback manually where needed.
omar (SRE): hotfix pushed at 2026-03-22T11:14Z (hotfix-540). reproc-441 started 2026-03-22T11:30Z. scorecard-service-bot updated 18 panels to "needs review".
pri (People Ops): closing loop for now 
If you see any more blank scorecards after reproc, reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
